_說明: 古堡 1624 咖啡館 Demo 素材（來源：S00 驗證素材）。實景照已轉正、裁成 9:16 並移除 EXIF；營業時間為虛構；現有實景照都是古堡園區景點、沒有咖啡館本身，正式 Demo 前建議補咖啡館照片。
name: 古堡 1624 咖啡館（Zeelandia Cafe）
selling_points: 安平古堡園區內的全戶外露天座位
復古紅磚木作吧台與手寫黑板菜單
安平古堡拿鐵、古堡咖啡、酸梅果飲（130–150 元）
address: 台南市安平區 安平古堡園區內

character.name: 鄭成功
character.anchor_zh: 鄭成功：明末武將形象，面容端正、目光有神，蓄八字鬍與短鬚，頭戴黑色烏紗帽，身穿深紅色明代圓領官袍，腰繫玉帶，黑色官靴。
character.anchor_en: Koxinga (Zheng Chenggong), a 17th-century Ming dynasty general with a dignified face, bright eyes, a thin mustache and short goatee, wearing a black Ming official's winged hat, a deep red round-collar Ming official robe with a jade belt, and black boots

scenes.description_zh: 熱蘭遮城城垣殘蹟：紅磚夾白灰的古城牆、草地與紅磚步道，晴天藍天
scenes.description_en: the ruined wall of Fort Zeelandia, old red bricks patched with white lime plaster, a lawn and a red-brick paved walkway under a clear blue sky

scenes.description_zh: 刻有「安平古堡」的石碑與花崗岩基座，後方榕樹與黃花，右側紅色古砲
scenes.description_en: a tall granite monument engraved with Chinese characters on a stepped stone base, banyan trees and yellow blossoms behind, red antique cannons at the side

scenes.description_zh: 仰望安平古堡白色瞭望塔，前方為紅磚牆與黑色古石牆，榕樹環繞
scenes.description_en: low-angle view of the white Anping Fort watchtower above old red-brick and dark stone walls, surrounded by banyan trees
